rows.original_alt: Atomic Energy Commission crews removing the damaged SL-1 reactor core from the Idaho facility after the 1961 accident.

rows.original_alt: Retrospective photograph showing severe damage inside the SL-1 reactor core after the 1961 prompt-critical excursion.

rows.rights_observation: Commons claims federal PD via INEEL; national laboratory / reused poster rights require item-level check before caching.
rows.historical_integrity: IMPORTANT: image is a 1981 poster/composite reusing a 1961 photograph, NOT a standalone 1981 incident photo; verify any ALT/caption depiction. Primary source p157.
